instagram.author: playfitnessadventure
instagram.body:
Would you do this workout? Let me know in the comments! 👇
Welcome back to roll your workout where we use a D20 to decide exactly what we're going to do today. I'm using this gorgeous liquid core dice. Let's see what we have in store. We're focused on strength and cardio. We'll roll this dice five times and use a D6 to decide how many times we're going to do it. Oh, 16 and that is 10 calf raises. Nine and that is glute bridges, 10 of them. One, 10 jumping jacks. 17, 30 seconds march in place and one last exercise. 18 which is 20 seconds back taps. How many times are we going to do this circuit? Two. Let's go. We'll do that one more time and that's it. A little bit of exercise is better than no exercise and that means we've earned the right to play fitness adventure and slay a dragon. Let's go. This is fitness adventure where because I worked out, I get to move my token one square, take this D20 and roll to attack. A bad start to this round. According to our dice guide, an 18 means our opponent takes two damage. Then one heart and two hearts. Because I colored in the heart with a one, that means I've unlocked the first chapter of the story. I love making working out less of a chore. And so if you want to be workout buddies with me, hit the follow button. And let's work out and slay dragons together.

tiktok.author: arielbolanddd
tiktok.body:
@Google @Fitbit you guys SUCK get this AI trash off the app #fitbit #googlehealth #aisucks #fitnesstracker #Fitness
I need to make a video about this because I cannot be the only one that feels this way. So I have a Fitbit. I have had this since January of this year. Love it. Loved it, should I say? It's really helped me track my sleep. It's really helped me make sure I get my step counted, see what my sleep looks like, all that stuff. But then in may they switched it over to Google Health and now it just uses a bunch of fucking AI on everything. And I fucking hate it to the point that I don't even want to use this anymore because I hate the fact that AI just has access to all of my fucking health now every second of the day. I hate it. I fucking hate it. Also they changed the app and so now everything is in a different fucking place. I have no idea where anything is. I had it. I had to resubmit my like permission to like log my period and stuff like that. Don't like that. The app's a fucking mess. Like the other version was so much easier to use. And now I get a I updates every single day about anything I do fitness wise and I don't want a fucking a I thing or an AI paragraph about whatever the fuck. Every single fucking day I don't want to use AI. I hate that it's being like shoved it down everyone's fucking throats. I didn't even have an option to be like, no, I don't want this. It just got transferred over and then suddenly it has access to all of my health information. I genuinely don't want this anymore. Like I actually am seriously considering getting rid of this and switching to a different one because this pisses me off now. Like that AI is tracking me every single fucking day. Companies, please stop using AI like this. No one fucking wants it. So if anyone has any recommendations of anything that's not Fitbit or Google Health, whatever the fuck it's called now, that uses the same functionality and doesn't use fucking AI, please let me know because I don't wanna fucking have this on my wrist anymore. Stop using AI.

tiktok.author: lifewith.sashh
tiktok.body:
this Trainerize crash is making me lowkey crash out
Alright, I have a question for all my fellow online fitness coaches. I have been using the app trainerize for two there's now as a coach and three years plus as a client. I am so over it. So I need to know what app are we using for our clients programming? Cause I don't do the old school Google DOC Google spreadsheet thing. Like I like my clients having an app where they could see all the workouts, where they could see training videos, where they have like their nutrition, daily habits, all that kind of stuff. And trainerize slash fitness app, whatever the heck it's called now has crashed on me so many times. It is literally. It literally just crashed on me mid check in. So I can't even do my client check ins right now. And I am very annoyed because my girls are waiting for me to get back to them and I'm not. I wanna transfer either to another coaching app or at this point I'm like, you know what? Maybe I'll just make my own. But seriously, what app are we using? I've seen kahunas, I've seen um, everfit, I've seen a couple different apps. I just. I'm over it. Can you just please drop your recommendations? Please and thank you.
